digest.component_or_area: store maintenance: fsck scan and compact-all sweep
propositions: Archived tickets dominate store-wide maintenance walks (fsck scan and compact-all sweep), making routine health checks slower as the store grows; default scopes must exclude archived tickets unless --include-archived is passed.
Archive operation must perform a terminal fold inline before writing the ARCHIVED event, ensuring just-archived tickets carry no unfolded events and do not require later compact-all visits.

Active-only iterator using .archived marker fast-path plus _is_net_archived confirmation must be the shared implementation for fsck and compact-all, matching the semantics already proven in default list command.

Both fsck and compact-all CLI commands must support --include-archived flag (with JSON passthrough and repair-path threading for fsck --repair) to restore full-walk behavior for audits and legacy ticket handling.

Reverted-archive tickets (stale marker but no net-archived event state) must remain visited by default; corrupt events in archived tickets must be invisible by default but reported (text and JSON, rc 1) when --include-archived is passed.

Store-wide metrics (authorship tally, signed/unsigned presence totals) must remain store-wide regardless of active-only scoping; active-only flag only narrows which findings are reported, not which are computed.
